title: 第六章 英雄联盟城际邀请赛第五章 我们不一样
lines: 欢迎学弟学妹加入沪政大家庭！
在沪政钟楼前的大广场上，迎新的横幅早早就已经拉起来了，沪政大学各系的学长学姐们就像是摆地摊一样，从教室里搬来桌子，支成了大大小小的迎新处。
有些比较细心的学姐还在旁边挂了大幅的海报，让学弟学妹们一眼就能看到自己应该往哪儿去，不至于跑错了门，可能是政法大学的关系，目光灼灼盯着新来小鲜肉的不光是师兄，师姐……也差不多，到了大三大四还没有男朋友的学姐，对于小哥哥也是非常感兴趣的，而且说真的，小学弟要纯要靠谱的多，对于大四还没有女朋友的，她们称之为c货。
除了指路，各大社团的团长们也是挖空心思，把自己招牌p的跟明星照一样，沪政最有名的当然是辩论社、篮球社、话剧社，尤其是辩论社那是在全国都顶尖的，基本上在沪政流行一句话，将来能做大律师的都是出自于辩论社，李牧同学大一的时候也兴冲冲的去了，然后……就没了。
四个人横着走，指指点点，司马仪的小宇宙绝对是爆发的状态，“哇，这个有85分啊，这一届真了不得，我有预感能出个和林曦雨叫板的！”
林曦雨已经制霸学校三年了，每次校花评选，当然是男生私下里搞的微信投票，连续三年第一，典型的美貌与智慧并存。
“咦，那边怎么那么多人？”范建国指着河边的一块，感觉至少围了几百人，什么社团这么夸张？
难道是来明星在学校拍戏？
由于环境优美，建筑风格有特点，很多青春电视剧都喜欢在学校里取景。
“没听说过啊，走去看看吧，在我们地盘上难道还有什么奇葩？”司马仪第一个冲了过去。
这也是一个摊位，走进的时候大牌子就非常醒目了根本不需要挤进去，硕大的“英雄联盟城际邀请赛”，旁边配的是林曦雨的高清照片，很多人大概是先看到美女才看到内容的。
条件很简单，5人组队参加选拔，最终的胜利者将获得参加城际赛的资格。
没多久司马仪一脸郁闷的走了出来，脸色有点难看。
“怎么了，像是尾巴被踩了？”范建国忍不住问道。
“麻蛋的，气死了，哪儿哪儿都有他，周旭阳这丫的又装逼，我就见不得他嚣张，什么叫我这样的就不要凑热闹了，我还偏偏凑热闹，不就是组一支队伍参赛吗！”
周旭阳，学生会主席，学校的风云人物，据说是周氏房产集团的继承人，超级富二代，长得帅，多才多艺，人气极高，现在网络小说中的典型反派，但实际上人家才是注定的成功校友。
司马仪跟这家伙有点犯冲，大二的时候两人一起追过林曦雨，结果可想而知，这不就有过节了，因为周旭阳的关系，司马仪学生会都退了。
“兄弟们，咱们组一支战队，干翻他们！”司马仪挥舞着拳头。
范建国和小白对视一眼，纷纷摇头，“司马，不是我说你，你跟那小子较什么劲，我俩什么水平，关键是小白还不会，牧哥，你会吗？就算会也没用，以周旭阳的做事风格，这么大张旗鼓八成就是给自己搭台，你这是自己撞上去找抽啊！”
司马仪愣了半响，寝室里，虽然他骚话最多，但范建国才是军师，用范建国的话，“我是诸葛亮，专溜司马仪”。
“你的意思是说，我上当了？”
“废话，周旭阳什么人，这么当众怼你肯定是激将法啊，你该不会报名费都交了吧？”范建国翻了翻白眼，一时不看着这小子就闯祸。
“哇靠，这也太阴了，500大洋啊，我这脸丢到太平洋了。”冷静下来的司马仪也是愤愤不平，五百块对他来说还好，只不过这事儿恐怕成了笑话，“要不，我们试试？”
范建国噗嗤一声笑了，“你还嫌丢人不够啊，我们俩充其量郊区黄金，小白……你知道大招是哪个键吗？还有牧哥，这游戏你玩过吗？”
“我玩过。”李牧点点头，其实他也一直在看，这城际赛是下业余赛中影响最大的比赛之一，没想到今年沪政也获得了名额，他还真有点心动，“要不试试？”
司马仪三人面面相觑，其实司马心里已经后悔了，当断则断，上去只会被吊打。
“牧哥，你没发烧吧，我们几个去打城际赛，司马是个逗比，你别搭理他，我可不想毕业前晚节不保。”范建国的脑袋摇的跟拨浪鼓一样。
水平不说，作为老玩家，他太清楚lol的水有多深了，上手容易想打好真不容易，正式比赛如果被虐，那真就成了笑柄。
“没事，大家愿意参加就行，重在参与，其他的交给我，我一个可以打五个！”李牧耐心的说道，想想那些石沉大海的邮件，这说不定是个机会，而且报名费都已经交了，老李家的家训就是不能浪费。
司马仪和范建国面面相觑，连小白都忍不住乐了，毕竟耳濡目染了这么长时间，“哈，哈哈老牧，你真玩过吗，这是个团队游戏，1打5你这是在逗我啊，咱不开玩笑行吗。”
“我真没玩笑，你们只要猥琐，其他的交给我，什么位置都行，再说，既然报名了，没道理怂。”李牧知道城际赛，这水平不高，以他的实力有很大把握，至少从学校突围是一点问题都没有。
“不干，纯粹找虐，知道我为什么混迹黄金从来不上铂金吗，就是舒服，宁为鸡头不为凤尾，这是我的人生哲学！”范建国脑袋摇的跟拨浪鼓一样。
“你是上不去好不好。”司马仪弱弱的说道。
“司马兔子，还不你拖累，我要有个好ad早上王者了！”
“咳咳，诸位，诸位，”一旁的白启实在忍不住了，“其实重点是我根本不会玩啊。”
“对啊，牧哥，我是想上的，可小白真没玩过，他的乐趣是唱唱歌，打打球，游戏什么的不上手的，你该不会说带着我三个也能赢吧？”
司马仪有点心动了，他敢报名也不是完全没准备，确实认识个高手。
“可以啊，我教小白，现学，小白可以玩个肉就在上路猥琐，其他的全交给我，我来carry！”李牧笑着说道。
“这么狠？司马，钱还能要回来吗？”范建国有一种绝望，小白是墙头草，根本没想法，李牧和司马仪明显是动心了，这叫明知山有沟，也要往里翻吗。
“你说呢？我是直接拍周旭阳脸上的，你们不知道，当时很爽的……”
content_en:
Welcome juniors and juniors to join the Huzheng family!
In the large square in front of the Huzheng Bell Tower, the welcome banners had been put up early. The seniors and seniors from various departments of Huzheng University were like setting up street vendors, moving tables from the classrooms and setting up large and small welcome areas.
Some of the more attentive seniors hung up large posters next to them, so that the juniors could see where they should go at a glance and avoid running to the wrong door. It might be related to the University of Political Science and Law. It was not just the seniors but also the seniors who were staring at the new kid... It was almost the same. The seniors who didn't have a boyfriend in their junior and senior years were also very interested in the younger brother, and to be honest, the juniors were much more trustworthy and pure. For the seniors who didn't have a girlfriend, they called them cunts.
In addition to giving directions, the leaders of the major clubs also worked hard to make their own signs look like celebrities. Of course, the most famous ones in Huzheng are the Debate Club, Basketball Club, and Drama Club, especially the Debate Club, which is the best in the country. Basically, there is a popular saying in Huzheng that those who will become barristers in the future are from the debate club. Li Mu also went there excitedly when he was a freshman, and then... it disappeared.
The four people walked sideways and pointed. Sima Yi's little universe was definitely in an explosive state. "Wow, this one has 85 points. This year is really amazing. I have a hunch that someone can challenge Lin Xiyu!"
Lin Xiyu has been dominating the school for three years. Every school beauty selection is, of course, a private WeChat vote among the boys. He has ranked first for three consecutive years, a typical beauty and wisdom coexisting.
"Hey, why are there so many people over there?" Fan Jianguo pointed to a spot by the river. It felt like there were at least hundreds of people surrounding it. What kind of club is so exaggerated?
Could it be that the celebrities are filming in the school?
Due to the beautiful environment and unique architectural style, many youth TV dramas like to shoot scenes in schools.
"I've never heard of it. Let's go and have a look. Is there anything weird on our territory?" Sima Yi was the first to rush over.
This is also a stall. When you walk in, the big brand is very eye-catching and there is no need to squeeze in. The huge "League of Legends Intercity Invitational Tournament" is accompanied by a high-definition photo of Lin Xiyu. Many people probably saw the beauty first before seeing the content.
The conditions are simple, five people form a team to participate in the selection, and the final winner will be qualified to participate in the intercity competition.
Not long after, Sima Yi walked out with a depressed look on his face, a bit ugly.
"What's wrong? It seems like my tail was stepped on?" Fan Jianguo couldn't help but ask.
"Damn it, I'm so angry. He's everywhere. Zhou Xuyang is so pretentious. I can't stand his arrogance. Why don't I join in the fun? I just join in the fun, isn't it just to form a team to compete!"
Zhou Xuyang, President of the Student Union, a popular figure in the school, is said to be the heir to Zhou's real estate group, a super rich second generation, handsome, versatile, and extremely popular. He is now a typical villain in online novels, but in fact he is an alumnus who is destined to be successful.
Sima Yi had some conflicts with this guy. When they were sophomores, they chased Lin Xiyu together. As you can imagine, there was a dispute. Because of Zhou Xuyang's relationship, Sima Yi even withdrew from the student union.
"Brothers, let's form a team and defeat them!" Sima Yi waved his fist.
Fan Jianguo and Xiaobai looked at each other and shook their heads, "Sima, I'm not talking about you. How can you compete with that kid? What's our level? The key is that Xiaobai doesn't know it yet. Brother Mu, do you know it? Even if you do, it's useless. With Zhou Xuyang's style of doing things, such a big fanfare is just to set up a stage for himself. You are going to hit him and get slapped on your own!"
Sima Yi was stunned for a while. Although he talked the most in the dormitory, Fan Jianguo was the strategist. In Fan Jianguo's words, "I am Zhuge Liang, and I specialize in sneaking around Sima Yi."
"You mean, I was fooled?"
"Nonsense, who is Zhou Xuyang? He must be trying to provoke you by attacking you in public like this. Didn't you pay the registration fee?" Fan Jianguo rolled his eyes and didn't look at this kid getting into trouble for a moment.
"Wow, this is too shady, 500 yuan, my face is lost in the Pacific Ocean." Sima Yi, who calmed down, was also indignant. Five hundred yuan was fine for him, but this matter may have become a joke, "How about we try?"
Fan Jianguo chuckled, "You're not embarrassed enough. We two are at best suburban gold, Xiaobai... Do you know which button is the ultimate move? And Brother Mu, have you ever played this game?"
"I've played it before." Li Mu nodded. In fact, he had been watching it. This intercity competition is one of the most influential competitions in the amateur competition. He didn't expect that Huzheng would also get a quota this year. He was really excited, "How about giving it a try?"
Sima Yi and the three of them looked at each other in shock. In fact, Sima already regretted it in his heart.
"Brother Mu, you don't have a fever, right? We are going to play in an intercity competition. Sima is a joke. Don't pay attention to him. I don't want to lose my life before graduation." Fan Jianguo shook his head like a rattle.
Level aside, as a veteran player, he is very aware of how deep the waters of LoL are. It is easy to get started but not easy to play well. If you are abused in the official game, it will really become a laughing stock.
"It's okay, as long as everyone is willing to participate, the important thing is to participate, leave the rest to me, I can fight five!" Li Mu said patiently, thinking about those emails that never came to light, this might be an opportunity, and the registration fee has been paid. The old Li family's family motto is not to waste.
Sima Yi and Fan Jianguo looked at each other, and even Xiaobai couldn't help but laugh. After all, he had been hearing and seeing it for so long, "Ha, haha, Old Mu, have you really played it before? This is a team game, 1 vs. 5. You are kidding me. Can't we just be kidding?"
"I'm really not joking. As long as you are naughty, leave the rest to me. Any position will do. Besides, since you have signed up, there is no reason to be timid." Li Mu knew that the level of the intercity competition was not high. With his strength, he was very sure that at least he would have no problem breaking out of the school.
"I won't do it. I'm just looking for abuse. Do you know why I work in gold and never go to platinum? It's just comfortable. I'd rather be a chicken head than a phoenix tail. This is my philosophy of life!" Fan Jianguo shook his head like a rattle.
"You can't go up, okay?" Sima Yi said weakly.
"Sima Rabbit, if you don't drag me down, I will have a good ad morning and become the king!"
"Ahem, everyone, everyone," Bai Qi couldn't help it anymore, "Actually, the point is that I don't know how to play at all."
"Yes, Brother Mu, I wanted to join, but Xiaobai has never played before. His fun is singing, playing ball, and he doesn't know how to play games. You don't think you can win with the three of me, right?"
Sima Yi was a little moved. He dared to sign up and it was not because he was completely unprepared. He did know a master.
"Okay, I'll teach Xiaobai, learn now. Xiaobai can play with it and be slutty on the road. Leave the rest to me. I'll carry!" Li Mu said with a smile.
"So cruel? Sima, can I still get the money back?" Fan Jianguo felt a sense of despair. Xiaobai was just a grassroots and had no idea at all. Li Mu and Sima Yi were obviously tempted. Is this called climbing in even though there is a ditch in the mountain?
"What do you think? I shot Zhou Xuyang's face directly. You don't know, but it was very satisfying at the time..."
title_en: Chapter 6 League of Legends Intercity Invitational Tournament Chapter 5 We are different
